title: Small cash envelope rotation
summary: A simple method for keeping emergency cash usable during card outages, bank closures, ferry disruption, fuel queues, or phone loss without advertising where money is kept.
content: Core sequence: 1) Split cash into daily-use and reserve envelopes so one mistake does not expose all money. 2) Use small notes for water, food, transport, phone charging, medicines, or official fees. 3) Record every use immediately because memory fails during queues and stress. 4) Check the envelope monthly and replace damaged notes or coins that are not accepted locally.
materials: small notes divided into two envelopes
expense log with date and reason
